mainEntity.name: When should my weight loss clinic consider investing in AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your weight loss clinic should consider investing in AI SEO if you are struggling to attract new patients online, want to outrank competitors in search results, or need to improve your website's visibility and organic traffic. It's particularly beneficial if you have limited marketing resources but need a high impact, data-driven strategy. Investing when you're looking to scale your patient base and establish a stronger digital presence is often ideal.
